# Profound Medical to Present 12-Month Data from FDA IDE Study Comparing the TULSA Procedure™ to Robotic Radical Prostatectomy at RSNA 2026; Conference Call to Follow


November 23, 2026 4:30pm EST


*CAPTAIN is the first Level 1 randomized controlled trial of an incisionless procedure versus robotic radical prostatectomy in organ-confined, intermediate-risk prostate cancer*


*Webcasted conference call to review the CAPTAIN data scheduled for November 30* *th* *at 4:30pm EST*


TORONTO, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Profound Medical Corp.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ac4Rs8FFSpl2jx_zNYxVY6rke9V5ftJ02hiSRb7i8CGYTp6WvuQWuRTG-LCIvyzG9Qyz1fmh5gky9LmmcLesqiArHtfGcVaOlhpuCMntN-w=) (NASDAQ:PROF; TSX:PRN) (“Profound” or the “Company”), a commercial-stage medical device company that develops and markets innovative interventional MRI (“iMRI”) procedures, today announced 12-month results from the Level 1 CAPTAIN randomized controlled trial comparing the TULSA Procedure™ with robotic radical prostatectomy (“RP”) in men with organ-confined, intermediate-risk, Grade Group 2 and 3 prostate cancer will be presented by Pejman Ghanouni, MD, PhD, of the Department of Radiology at Stanford Medicine, at the Radiological Society of North America Annual Meeting (“RSNA 2026”) in Chicago, IL, on November 30, 2026.


“We are excited by this opportunity to share the 12-month data from CAPTAIN, a potentially paradigm-changing Level 1 study designed to provide the first true apples-to-apples comparison of the safety, quality of life and oncological control of two prostate cancer treatment modalities,” Arun Menawat, Profound’s CEO and Chairman. “We look forward to discussing these important findings with researchers, clinicians, and investors as we continue to build the body of rigorous clinical evidence pointing to the promise the TULSA Procedure holds in becoming a mainstream treatment modality across the entire prostate disease spectrum.”


**CAPTAIN Trial 12-Month Results Conference Call Details:**


Profound is pleased to invite all interested parties to participate in a conference call to discuss the CAPTAIN data following the presentation at RSNA 2026.


**Date:** Monday, November 30, 2026


**Time:** 4:30 p.m. ET


**Live Call Registration:**[https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIbe4d038184bc43179f75ca9d15d42e2b](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3g56VakKAf9-CLzl_aQid7ZsXU948fPtTMsx8XhQAWR4SWFvFXcT-frPprBvTCkuatvHX433RekqPFq7vFyS4xXhr_v66efoahkJrZbcIKCFi36XOw2YUmEYAZI2oaJG5qlnY64SXu62fxBhVOeKbZa4E87e19AS64T0sJUN2GrcGm1iwRbGajlBLVj1q4sB1LemlmfEGAmeabrdyqsqz7Poi3Sh3LNmBm7g_UXjshRd-nyVI717kMmyOmkyNVcV)


The call will also be broadcast live and archived on the Company's website in the Investors section[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=BW9PHS-6svaNEFX-W5b--XnMRJJzQL_OOQlM_-CuvvL00fut9iGSnQBnRR_Tb4ZpaFNNNdgq4iUyDxdCdx9MZF2rwQpC7mazaJbIvOpOmnbc0yvvl-jeZwAb_ZAsiMdk) .


**About Profound Medical Corp.**


Profound is a commercial-stage medical device company and an innovator in interventional MRI (iMRI) procedures. The company’s flagship platform,[TULSA-PRO](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8D0S4EZb2bmtF6LnHNKEAZnCRPnAlcUT4HSZFrJGVzO9XVczkL53j9llTUnF29UBFVJw-CS907h5nDWr3hIMKrX5PIGLPtjVKg7_soBAtAg=)[®](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ZVtxQizQuaYnE9sKTDCK9nX2B1O0NRHvve-y2HRWjJ16niFVEAEulAZ7D8vpwu9ztFLGCXVB09qwdUJPvVzmCjw9Tcgh4I5nZdPYC5KZSjI=) , enables MRI-guided, incision-free prostate ablation. Physicians use the[TULSA Procedure™](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8D0S4EZb2bmtF6LnHNKEAXwyPqEAecHfGm86xlQg4TCxGcId_wkUhJxR2tP32-QJpWoTP3n-PUDun7a6WfRBx5XI5HRfqfdEbEr32kG9KDXyLh9BmkBNW7KS2olCXOAat3akdvq-dO13IHWh4vZkSA==) to see, ablate, and confirm therapy in real time, supporting personalized treatment strategies across the continuum of prostate care—from whole-gland to subtotal, hemi, multifocal, and focal treatment. This approach enables individualized care using prostate tissue ablation, while minimizing the potential of the side effects that are typically associated with surgery or radiation, such as urinary incontinence and/or erectile dysfunction.


Profound also commercializes[Sonalleve](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dhStsswXF0YanXh-kEp1l9gUpv4lM4BH48neZEofMuabnYjYRDvdrg7DCzCPY9bBG2eqTz2LqfYKMmJBDSxxQ4umZL7n8gPF9vzcV3JWjXU=)[®](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=fx1_iTST00kUqOcpYof8e-tCXLpw6s0hc4KhWvJASjxahzIL7E8DNUBX4SxCJi2VgFBUgR9Kt0C1a4tEKHqceajQYBnWpfw0GWG4UEyG4gU=) , an MRI-guided therapy that provides a non-surgical treatment option for pain palliation of bone metastases, desmoid tumors, and osteoid osteoma, as well as for common gynecologic conditions including uterine fibroids and adenomyosis. Sonalleve delivers targeted therapy with no incisions, no blood loss during the procedure, no overnight hospital stay, and faster recovery — and, in gynecologic applications, enables uterine-sparing treatment that may help preserve fertility. Profound is also exploring additional clinical applications for Sonalleve, including non-invasive ablation of abdominal cancers and hyperthermia-based cancer therapies.


Profound Medical’s technologies are approved across major global markets. TULSA-PRO is cleared by the FDA in the United States for transurethral ultrasound ablation (TULSA) of prostate tissue. In addition, TULSA-PRO is cleared for use in various jurisdictions including Europe, Canada, Saudi Arabia, India, Australia/New Zealand, and the UAE. Sonalleve is approved by the FDA as HDE in the United States for the treatment of osteoid osteomas in the extremities. Sonalleve is also cleared or approved in Europe, Canada, China, and Saudi Arabia.


Through real-time MRI guidance and data-driven innovation, Profound is advancing the future of MRI-guided therapy — expanding access to precise, personalized, and incision-free treatment options worldwide.
